resources.string: The camera is needed to read the cards. Frames are processed on this phone only; nothing is saved or uploaded.

The card recognition model is not included in this build.
The card recognition model could not be started on this phone.
You are ahead: bet if nobody has bet, raise if someone has.
Check if you can. If someone bets, calling is fine at any size.
Check if you can. Call a bet up to about %1$d%% of the pot; fold to bigger bets.
Check if you can. If anyone bets, fold.
Waiting for the flop to be fully visible…
Add a card the camera missed
The app will take photos of each of your 52 cards so a recognition model can be trained on your own deck. The camera is needed for this.
Lay this card face up and flat on the table inside the square. Press Start, then move the phone slowly (closer, farther, a little tilted) until the bar is full.
Remove all cards. Point the camera at the empty table, press Start and move the phone slowly.
All photos taken in Learn my cards will be removed from this phone.
Tips: good light, no glare on the cards, the whole card inside the square. Use ‹ › to go back or skip. Photos stay on this phone until you press Send.
Could not create the photo package. Check free storage and try again.
The photo could not be taken. Try again.
Not sure about these. Tap the ones that are right:
This game is played without 2s to 5s; remove those cards.
The same card is marked twice.
Too many opponents for the cards left. Lower the number of opponents.
Hi-Lo: the chance includes winning half the pot with the low hand.
Put the phone on a stand in front of the computer so the camera sees the game. The camera is needed for this.
Drag a box around YOUR cards on the picture
Drag a box around the BOARD cards on the picture

Tips: keep the phone still on a stand, fill the picture with the game window, turn the screen brightness down a little if the picture shines, and avoid lamps reflecting on the monitor. Mark the two areas once; they are remembered.
Wrong card? Tap its box and choose the right one. A card that was missed? Tap its corner (number and suit) and choose it. The app remembers your answers and reads these cards better next time.
Read as %1$s. What card is it?
Nothing learned yet: correct the cards after each photo and the app will learn them.
Everything the app learned from your corrections will be erased (useful if the game changed its card design completely).
Manual mode on: tap + to choose cards · tap again to use the camera
